title: SnapshotManifest
description: snapshot/manifest.json -- the sealed identity record for one snapshot bundle (engineering plan section 8.1). ADR-017: pins tool, schema, registry, evaluator, PowerShell, tenant/cloud, and collection/evaluation versions in every assessment.

snapshotId.description: Stable, unique identifier for this snapshot. Referenced by every assessment evaluated against it (section 8.3).

tenantScope.description: Tenant/cloud scope pseudonym or ID, per the profile's redaction mode (section 10.2 -- redaction occurs at export, so this may already be pseudonymized depending on how the manifest itself is persisted).

cloud.description: Only Microsoft public/commercial cloud is supported in v1 (ADR-032). Unsupported clouds must be rejected before this manifest is ever constructed, not represented as a value here.

authMode.description: ADR-006: client secrets, managed identity, and persistent token caches are excluded from v1.

status.description: Partial snapshots are permitted but must be visibly marked (ADR-015) -- never silently indistinguishable from a complete snapshot.

partialReason.description: Enforced non-null when status is 'Partial' and enforced null when status is 'Sealed' by this schema's allOf/if/then rules above -- always present as a key either way.

sealedAt.description: When validation completed and the integrity record was written (section 8.3) -- distinct from collectionEndUtc.
